profile.headline: Software Engineer Manager - Kronos
profile.summary: Accomplished Solutions Analyst with distinguished performance in the workforce industry. Portfolio of achievements includes managing revenue, schedules and improving work objectives. Broad based background encompasses exceptional work ethic and commitment to organizational objectives. Proactive manager, team builder and tactical planner with the ability to train and motivate individuals

positions.title: Software Engineer Manager - UKG Global Time & Absence
Senior Business System Analyst - Kronos Global Time
positions.description:
Kronos/ADP eTime configuration experience

Full life cycle Implementation of a Kronos based Time solution

Full life cycle Implementation of global ADP eTime deployment for Europe Asia and South America countries

Experience with Success Factors/SAP/WorkDay and integration to those applications.

Experience developing functional specifications and source to target mapping

Experience with integration to third party vendors

Experience working with offshore and virtual teams

Strong working knowledge of core HR business processes: Payroll, Time Keeping, and Personnel Administration and SAP HR master data

Experience with PA, OM or US Payroll configuration in SAP is a plus

Experience working directly with geographies outside the United States preferred

Excellent verbal and written communication and collaboration skills to effectively communicate with both business and technical IT teams

Self-starter with leadership qualities who can work independently and in teams on tasks and projects with limited supervision

Mentoring and training BSA and Stakeholders.

positions.title: Solutions and Support Analyst - Kronos
positions.description:
Work effectively with cross-functional teams, field resources and times customers to ensure that HR system 	

Interact frequently with team, management and internal customers to define project requirements and identify solutions consistent with defined terms, methodology, policy, and regulations. 

Develop strong customer relationships as ‘trusted advisor’ at Global Teams, payroll manager, and senior management levels.

Pay strong attention to detail as well as the ability to function strategically within a project, proactively look at the ‘big picture’ for project short and long term goals.
Perform business rule analysis

Configure software applications

Conduct application orientation for customers

Analyze enhanced requirements and create process documentation, diagrams and feature specifications.

Business process requirements gathering

Understand and configuring software interfacing products

Consult customers on system configuration, industry specific features and system processes and procedures

Troubleshoot complex customer environments.

positions.title: Assistant Men Basketball Coach
positions.description:
Assisted the Head Basketball coach with instructing players in the rules, regulations, equipment, and techniques of the sport

Organized and directed individual and small group practice activities/exercises as directed by the head Basketball coach.

Assesses player’s skills, monitors players during competition and practice, and keeps the head Basketball coach informed of the athletic performance of students

Assisted with determining game strategy.

Assisted the head Basketball coach with supervising athletes during practices and competition. Follows established procedures in the event of an athlete’s injury

Models sports-like behavior and maintained appropriate conduct towards players, officials, and spectators

Maintained the equipment room in orderly condition and assumes responsibility for its security.

Distributed equipment, supplies, and uniforms to students.

Assisted the head Basketball coach with submitting a list of award winners at the end of the season.

Participated in special activities to include parent’s night, banquets, award nights, and pep assemblies.

Performed support tasks such as distributing and maintaining eligibility forms, emergency data cards, and other related records.

Attended staff development meetings, clinics and other professional activities to improve coaching performance

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Work effectively with cross-functional teams, field resources and times customers to manage assigned projects.

Develop and manage project plans, schedules, reports and budget. Track and monitor all deliverables, calendars and meetings necessary. Set and performance goals for project team and work unit.

Manage all follow-up items and track resolution through to completion. Provide regular action item reporting.

Prepare and facilitate regularly scheduled project team meeting and monthly executive status meetings.

Manage escalated situations as proactively as possible, involving management as needed.

Interact frequently with team, management and customers to define project requirements and identify solutions consistent with defined terms, methodology, policy, and regulations. 

Develop strong customer relationships as ‘trusted advisor’ at project management, payroll manager, and senior management levels.

Pay strong attention to detail as well as the ability to function strategically within a project, proactively look at the ‘big picture’ for project short and long term goals.

positions.title: Application Consultant
positions.description:
Implement data collection devices

Implement software in multi-vendor environments

Perform business rule analysis

Configure software applications

Conduct application orientation for customers

Analyze enhanced requirements and create process documentation, diagrams and feature specifications.

Business process requirements gathering

Understand and configuring software interfacing products

Consult customers on system configuration, industry specific features and system processes and procedures

Troubleshoot complex customer environments.

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
Develop in-depth product knowledge on Kronos Workforce Solutions.

Leverage HR and Payroll domain expertise to provide optimum solutions

Analyze, research and troubleshoot to solve complex customer issues

Use and contribute to on line product knowledgebase in order to resolve issues quickly.

Demonstrate ability to multi-task in order to prioritize support issues and respond appropriately to multiple critical situations

Manage case load and accurately document defined problem statements, troubleshooting efforts, results, next steps and resolution.

Develop general product knowledge on Kronos Workforce Central Suite products and other additional designated module.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant – Men’s Basketball
positions.description:
Assisted in all aspects of the coaching and management of the basketball program

Recruited and scouted in accordance with the NAIA Division I policies and procedures

Trained and coached student-athletes in the program

Supported the academic and personal development of all student-athletes

Assisted in developing basketball camps and clinics

Complied with the rules and regulations of the NAIA as it relates to the program

Participated and helped organize community service projects

Videotape and game tape exchange responsibilities, and Updated all social media websites on a weekly basis

positions.title: Mixologist/Accountant
positions.description:
Prepared financial statements and reports

Initiated and maintain the capital lease accounting

Assist with Audit

Take beverage orders from servers or directly from guests or patrons

Collect method of payment for food or beverage

Maintained a clean and sanitize environment

Order supplies as needed

Mix drink ingredients and served as ordered.
